steps.say: Teaching on your own rather than inside a school means one seat, for you. Choose Monthly or Annual above — annual works out at two months free.
**Subscribe** opens the card panel on this page. Your students pay for their own learning separately, so three paying students cover what your dashboard costs.
Once it is running, this same button becomes **Manage subscription**, which is where invoices and cancellation live.
steps.terminal: That is the tutor plan — a single seat, and it is yours. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
